'''Wyrlan'''<ref name="LOTF-I">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref> was an officer in the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] who was with [[Ben Skywalker]] when he had made his first kill during a raid on suspected [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] terrorists.<ref name="LOTF-B" /> He would later guard Ben along with [[Garsi]] as [[Tahiri Veila]] tortured former GAG officer [[Lon Shevu]] to death. After Ben neutralized Tahiri with their weapons, Wyrlan and Garsi willingly allowed Ben to escape after threatening them with death if they tried to stop him.<ref name="LOTF-I" />
